// Fixture — should NOT be flagged.
//
// An exported *Service method that takes NO parameters cannot
// carry user-supplied IDs into PathJoin, so v1 treats it as out
// of scope. Status / ListRoot / similar nullary methods are the
// most common shape this exempts.

package fixture

type Result struct {
	OK bool
}

type Service struct{}

func PathJoin(parts ...string) string {
	out := ""
	for _, p := range parts {
		out += p + "/"
	}
	return out
}

// Status reports the service home dir. Takes no input from the
// caller; PathJoin operates on a constant prefix.
func (s *Service) Status() Result {
	root := PathJoin("/data", "root")
	_ = root
	return Result{OK: true}
}
